title: Black hole to white hole (Planck stars)
example_questions: What if a black hole turned into a white hole?
What is at the centre of a black hole?
summary: In loop quantum gravity inspired models, collapsing matter never reaches a singularity. Quantum pressure at Planck density makes it bounce. Inside, the bounce is quick, but extreme time dilation means outsiders see the black hole for a very long time before it turns into a white hole and releases what fell in.
support_note: A serious proposal within loop quantum gravity; no observational evidence yet.
what_happens: Matter collapses to Planck density instead of a singularity
Seen from outside, the black hole lasts a very long time
It ends as a white hole that releases its contents
objections: Depends on loop quantum gravity, which is unconfirmed

sources.title: Black hole fireworks: quantum gravity effects outside the horizon spark black to white hole tunneling
